# Prometheus scrape failures causing gaps in dashboards

Grafana panels show gaps; some targets appear to have no data for stretches of time.

A service started exposing a high-cardinality metric (per-request label), so scrapes exceeded the timeout and sample limit and were dropped, creating gaps.

1. Identify the target failing scrapes and the high-cardinality metric
2. Drop or aggregate the offending label via metric_relabel_configs
3. Raise scrape_timeout modestly if still needed
4. Confirm the target scrapes reliably and gaps disappear

Error Details
```
Prometheus target DOWN: 'context deadline exceeded'; scrape_duration > scrape_timeout; too many series causing 'sample limit exceeded'
```

Tags: monitoring, prometheus, scrape-timeout, high-cardinality, sample-limit
